name: Advance Grinding
verdict: Paid channels (Meta and Google Ads) show zero spend, leads, and clicks over the past 28 days, suggesting campaigns are paused or inactive. Google Business Profile is the only active source, driving 129 total actions (102 directions, 25 web clicks, 2 calls), though GBP engagement dropped 26.19% week over week, likely due to reduced organic search demand or seasonal slowdown.

performance.verdict: Paid channels fully dark; GBP sole signal and now fading.

GA4 sessions and Search Console clicks are both 0 for all 28 days, suggesting site tracking is broken or the website is receiving no measurable organic traffic.
